name: v1.8.12
body:
## What's Changed
* Promote registry v1.8.11 to production and switch on the usage collector by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1886
* Remove four dashboard panels that their neighbours already cover by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1887
* Manage production's alert rules and Discord contact point from the repository by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1888

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/compare/v1.8.11...v1.8.12

name: v1.8.11
body:
## What's Changed
* Increase isolated production database to eight vCPUs by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1873
* Promote registry v1.8.10 to production by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1874
* Provision the UI-built Grafana dashboards from the repository by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1875
* Provision the Grafana alert rules and Discord contact point from the repository by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1876
* Add usage collector for the hosted registry by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1877
* Run the usage collector daily and show its results in Grafana by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1878
* Fix the staging deploy: put the usage collector's generated credentials in Secret data by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1880
* Retire the usage collector in staging to rehearse switching it off by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1881
* Switch the usage collector back on in staging by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1882
* Size the usage collector's log read by counting, and fix quiet days by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1883
* Judge usage drift only where there is enough evidence for it by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1884


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/compare/v1.8.10...v1.8.11
